posts.title: How to install an app on your Commodore 64
posts.description: It’s time to install an app! But here in 1986, we still call them “programs,” not apps. So, you’ll want to set aside some time to get started installing a program. Since you have a Commodore 64, there are really only two options for getting new programs this month: COMPUTE!’s Gazette and RUN , and you have to hope that one of those magazines isn’t sold out at the book store. posts.title: The new robber barons aren’t ready for the fight
posts.description: Ten years ago, I began writing a series about how we could move toward humane tech .
